name: riddle-benchmark
description: A dataset of textual riddles intended to evaluate language models' common-sense and lateral reasoning ability by requiring concise, often single-word answers. Tasks typically require interpreting figurative language, puns, and implicit clues to arrive at the correct solution. Performance measures how well models can map linguistic hints to a specific target answer.
reputation: Niche benchmark hosted on Hugging Face used in some community evaluations of reasoning; limited widespread adoption.
